plan.notes: Transcribed from the official CRC 'Theatre Arts AA-T Degree' program map, Catalog Year 2026-2027, published September 23, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/7896/PublishedPdf). GE Pattern: Cal-GETC. Map states Total Units 53-62; lower bound 53 used = 13+16+11+13 (semester sums verified at lower bounds: List A slots 1-3 units -> 1 each; Area 2 slot 3-4 -> 3). List A (minimum 3 units; one TAP course each semester): TAP 300/320/340/360 Rehearsal and Performance I or TAP 310/330/350/370 Technical Production I (1-3 units each; audition/instructor permission or interview per course); students may use 3 units of Rehearsal & Performance or 3 units of Technical Production for the core requirement. List B (minimum 9 units): TA 305, TA 351 (requires TA 350), TA 420, TA 422, TA 430, and TAP courses — one 3-unit selection sequenced in each of Semesters 2-4; a different course per slot; if Rehearsal & Performance was used in the core, select Technical Production here and vice versa. TA 350 prerequisite is TA 340 or instructor permission; TA 340 is not sequenced in the map and is carried under external_prereqs. The two Cal-GETC Area 4 slots must total 6 units from 2 disciplines per the map.
